sentences.en: Judge him by what he does, not by his appearance.
sentences.zh: 根据他的行为来评判他，而不是看外表。

sentences.en: We cannot separate the sheep from the goats by appearance.
sentences.zh: 我们不能仅凭外表把绵羊和山羊分开。

sentences.en: Judging from her appearance, she seems to be very rich.
sentences.zh: 从她的外表来看，她似乎非常富有。
